reviewed_document: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md
summary: BE3-1..10 在文档层均已闭环；新发现 Store/API 跨 package unexported 调用不可实现，以及 TeacherInput 引用了当前不存在的 LessonOrdinal 字段。

previous_findings.evidence: Registry Result=ok; queued/pending are separated across receipt/outbox.
One auditPilotLifecycleTx dispatch is specified across listed facades.
pilot-audit-map/v1 explicitly maps the raw Registry Args while preserving raw audit result/timing.
Isolated App, task, private contexts, local Registry auditor and two bounded calls are specified.
v2 DDL is unchanged; strict active verifier is required.
Receipt lookup precedes CAS and unknown commit remains pending_unknown without rollback inference.
Outbox kind and typed normalized payloads distinguish Registry input from output.
Per-file build tag and production package graph exclusion checks are specified.
Post-commit response drop checks committed rows independently; pre-commit no-record claim requires proven rollback.
State codec fields and v2 row mapping are frozen.

findings.title: API package cannot call suggested unexported Store methods or construct Store opaque actor
findings.recommendation: Freeze a compilable cross-package API with non-forgeable opaque capability creation/verification in Store; or move orchestration into one package. Avoid any/SQL callbacks/public arbitrary fields.

findings.title: TeacherInput.LessonOrdinal does not exist in current code
findings.recommendation: Remove the nonexistent field and gate Decide using verified server-side ordinal, or explicitly design the type extension and all call-site defaults/regressions.

findings.title: Audit map schema_version meaning ambiguous
findings.recommendation: Define whether it versions the tool argument schema or remove it as redundant with pilot-audit-map/v1; document upgrade rules.

findings.title: Trusted nickname snapshot source/normalization is underspecified
findings.recommendation: Name the authoritative account field and define one normalization/freeze point consistently used by middleware, Store replay validation and greeting fingerprint.
